title: Marketing Lab Truth and Five-Dimension Quality Evaluator

notes: Adds a Kairo-owned, candidate-identity-blind evaluator for already-collected synthetic/public-safe Marketing Lab paired evidence.
The evaluator uses the existing AgentRuntimePort critic role with zero tools and a fixed Kairo rubric; neither candidate can self-award benchmark evidence.
Truth must fail when visible candidate content asserts factual, technical, experiential, quantitative or capability details not entailed by the supplied benchmark Claims.
Quality evidence is bounded to the existing brandFit, hookQuality, originality, formatQuality and criticScore dimensions; benchmark thresholds and comparator policy are unchanged.
No human preference, edit-distance evidence, final verdict, VS-23/VS-24 activation, API wiring, migration, deployment or production enablement is in scope.

approvals.rationale: Owner said Go after the VS-64 to VS-65 handoff and evaluator implementation were stated as the immediate next governed action; issue #116 records the exact evaluator scope and constraints.

VS-65 does not change benchmark thresholds, candidate eligibility, advancement policy, human-evidence requirements or production permissions; it implements the already-required Kairo-owned Truth and five-dimension evidence contract.

Owner explicitly authorized continuing with the governed handoff and evaluator implementation. Work remains non-production and must pass normal deterministic, CI and security gates before any merge or execution.
Requires an immutable exact-head candidate with repository CI/security evidence.
No release or deployment is authorized by VS-65 implementation approval.
No production evaluator execution or production enablement is authorized.
